description: This Java source file defines a utility/helper class for managing business step configurations in integration tests related to Apache Fineract. It includes methods for fetching, serializing, updating, and handling business step data via REST API calls, and contains deprecated methods indicating a transition to a newer client approach.

classes.name: BusinessStepConfigurationHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for interacting with business step configurations in integration tests, including fetching and updating business steps via REST API.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Serializes a list of BusinessStep objects into a JSON string wrapped in a BusinessStepWrapper.

methods.name: configuredBusinessStepFromJsonString
methods.description: Deserializes JSON string into a JobBusinessStepConfigData object.

methods.name: configuredApiParameterErrorFromJsonString
methods.description: Deserializes JSON string into an ApiParameterError object.

methods.name: availableBusinessStepFromJsonString
methods.description: Deserializes JSON string into a JobBusinessStepDetail object.

methods.name: getConfiguredBusinessStepsByJobName
methods.description: Fetches configured business steps for a given job name via REST API.

methods.name: getAvailableBusinessStepsByJobName
methods.description: Fetches available business steps for a given job name via REST API.

methods.name: updateBusinessStepOrder
methods.description: Updates the order of business steps for a specific job via REST API.

methods.name: updateBusinessStepOrderWithError
methods.description: Attempts to update the order of business steps and returns potential API error info.
